notice.title: A quick heads-up before you start
notice.intro: 2nd-Brain keeps your entries private and stores them encrypted. When you use an AI feature, content needed for that feature may be sent to OpenAI or Anthropic; older app versions, or builds or runtimes without the dedicated vendor settings may route it to Google Gemini. Please review the required processing below before continuing.
notice.trustTitle: Your records are not for sale
notice.trustBody: Your entries are not sold or used for advertising. Automatic safety checks and service audit records do not, by themselves, trigger an additional transfer of entry text to an AI provider.
notice.items: Collected: your email, date of birth, and the entries you write (journals, notes, captures).
notice.purposeService: Used to run the service: saving your entries, your growth graph, and your assistant.
notice.retention: Kept while your account is active. You can delete entries or your whole account any time from Settings.
notice.rights: You can decline the optional item below and still use the app. Declining a required item means we cannot provide the service.

detail.title: What you're agreeing to
detail.intro: Plain-language detail for each item you check at sign-up: what it covers, why it is needed, and what your choices are.

service.title: Collection and use to run the service
service.body:
What we collect: your email address, date of birth, and the entries you write (journals, notes, captures).
Why: to run your account, store your entries, draw your growth graph, power your assistant, and confirm you are 14 or older.
How long: while your account is active. You can delete entries or your whole account any time from Settings; deleted data is destroyed without undue delay.
Your choice: you can decline, but this item is essential to provide the service, so sign-up cannot continue without it.

llmProcessing.title: Processing entries for AI responses
llmProcessing.body:
What happens: when you use an AI feature, text requests and the related entries needed for that feature are sent to the configured provider: OpenAI or Anthropic, or Google Gemini for older app versions, or builds or runtimes without the dedicated vendor settings. Images and audio may be processed for image analysis or voice transcription, and entry content may be processed to generate embeddings if server-side record-search indexing is enabled.
Purpose: responses, analysis, generation, and voice transcription that you request and, when enabled, embeddings for record search.
Safety and audit: automatic safety checks currently use rule-based checks in the app and service gateway. Service audit records store hashes instead of raw text, together with metadata such as provider, model, processing purpose, and processing time. Safety checks and audit records do not by themselves cause an additional transfer of raw text to an AI provider.
What we do not do: we do not sell entries, use them for advertising, or send raw text that is not needed for the requested feature or health and activity measurements to an AI provider.
Your choice: you may decline, but AI processing is necessary for the core Service, so sign-up cannot continue without this acknowledgement.

overseasTransfer.title: Processing outside your country
overseasTransfer.body:
Who receives it: Supabase, Inc. (United States; authentication, database hosting, and Edge Functions, with primary storage in Seoul), OpenAI OpCo, LLC (United States), Anthropic PBC (United States), and Google Gemini for older app versions, or builds or runtimes without the dedicated vendor settings.
What is transferred: Supabase processes account and entry data, content needed for the requested service function, and request metadata. An AI provider receives only the text, related entries, images, or audio needed for the AI feature you use; if server-side record-search indexing is enabled, entry content may also be processed to generate embeddings.
When and how: data is sent over TLS while you use the Service. Supabase Edge Functions are not currently region-pinned and may run in South Korea or abroad. AI content is sent only when you use an AI feature.
How long: account data and User Content follow the periods in Section 3 of the Privacy Policy. Supabase API and function logs are retained for one day under the current Free plan. AI-provider retention and exceptions follow the provider-specific terms and actual service tier and settings described in Section 5; no unverified account-specific period is asserted here.
Your choice: sign-up cannot continue without acknowledging this essential overseas processing. After sign-up, you may request account deletion to stop future use of the Service and future overseas processing.

sensitiveData.title: How sensitive entries are handled
sensitiveData.body:
What this covers: journals and notes may naturally include sensitive details, such as health or beliefs.
How we handle it: we do not collect or sort it separately; everything stays encrypted, private account data. It is never made public, sold, or used for ads.
Your choice: what you write is entirely up to you, and you can delete any entry at any time.
If you decline: we cannot store your entries without this acknowledgement, so sign-up cannot continue.

safetyNotice.title: How safety routing works
safetyNotice.body:
What this covers: if your writing contains wording that suggests a crisis, 2nd-Brain shows the relevant help lines.
How we handle it: we record THAT the routing happened (the trigger category, the template version, the locale) so we can check the routing still works. We do not store a clinical severity score, and we do not keep the text that triggered it.
What it is not: 2nd-Brain is not an emergency service. It does not call anyone, does not report on your behalf, does not notify a guardian, school, or institution, and does not monitor you. In an emergency, contact the emergency services directly.
Your choice: this is a separate consent under PIPA art.23 because the record is treated as health-related data.
If you decline: sign-up cannot continue, because we would have no basis for the safety record.

marketing.title: Product updates (optional)
marketing.body:
What you get: an occasional email about new features and improvements.
Optional: declining changes nothing about the app.
Withdraw any time: from Settings, or with the unsubscribe link in any email.

detail.footer: Questions? Ask any time from Settings, Support. We reply within 2 business days.

privacy.title: You decide what leaves your account
privacy.subtitle: Sharing, profiling, analytics, and model training all start off.
privacy.speech: Your records stay private unless you turn on a control. Teens stay locked to high-privacy.
privacy.trustBody: Your entries are stored encrypted. Ads never appear unless you turn them on yourself, and even then your entries are never used for ads. 2nd-Brain does not sell your data.
privacy.minorLockNote: You are on a teen account, so high-privacy stays on. Long-term memory is the only switch you can turn on.

ops_push.label: Routine push
ops_push.desc: Keep handing approved routine items to your calendar and share sheet without asking each time. Off asks again on the next push.

sharing.label: Sharing

recommendations.label: Recommendations

llm_training.desc: Keep off unless you choose to let content help improve models. Off keeps entries out of training.

persona_share.label: Profile sharing

long_term_memory.label: Long-term memory
